subject: english
stem: A store added seats and visitors stayed longer. No survey asked why. What can be said?
options: The seats made every visitor stay longer, so the cause is fully proven
The seats and longer visits are related, but cause is not proven
Seats certainly caused every visitor to stay

optionRationales.reason: 資料只顯示座位與較長停留同時出現，沒有 seats were removed 的資料，也不能把每位訪客的因果關係說成已完全證明。
The store had no visitors：原文有 visitors。
The seats and longer visits are related, but cause is not proven：同時變化但缺少 why evidence。
Seats certainly caused every visitor to stay：過度因果與 every。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「事件先後、機制與結果共同支持原因方向」可推出 The seats and longer visits are related, but cause is not proven；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The seats and longer visits are related, but cause is not proven 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
